description: Wyckoff Day Trading Timing Model for futures. Rebuild of a Replit/Streamlit app as a static browser app on GitHub Pages, with GitHub Actions doing the Yahoo Finance ingestion. Data source is Yahoo (yfinance) seeded from a 15-month 1-minute ES export. The repo is the datastore AND the source of truth.
loadInstruction: Clone the repo, then read canonicalFiles.projectFiles IN ORDER. Read session-state/latest-resume-note.md FIRST — it is the single source of 'where we are'. Then session-state/DECISIONS.md (why things are the way they are, including the finding that killed the original directional premise). Then master-spec.md. Then engine/zigzag.js IN FULL. Report the 6 points in reportOnLoad, then WAIT for direction. Do not start building on load.
reportOnLoad: engine understanding (ZigZag rule, wave table, BW/BV, extension) and its verification status
pipeline understanding (Yahoo constraints, cadence, store format) and whether the Action has ever run green
data coverage (symbols, months, session count, known gaps)
build state — which sections are specified / built / verified

dataStore.format: columnar {t,o,h,l,c,v}; t is epoch milliseconds UTC
dataStore.note: Bars are 3-minute, resampled from Yahoo 1m. Yahoo has NO 3m interval and serves 1m for only ~7 days, so the Action must run at least weekly. A gap longer than 7 days is PERMANENT.

verification.zigzagPivots: 24/24 reproduced exactly against the original Streamlit app

environment.cloudSandbox: CAN git clone from github.com (verified 2026-08-23). CANNOT push — no credentials. Delivery to the repo goes through the user.
environment.googleDrive: NOT USED. Unlike the gex project there is no Drive mirror. Do not create one; the repo is the only store.
